Baju/tunik gelap penuh dan palet/cahaya bulan editorial.
Satu kaki pengganggu dewasa sebagai pembanding dan efekkutukan tanpa luka; gerak ludah natural tidak bercahaya.
prompt: Targeted anatomical correction ONLY on the raised palm at LEFT of this original image. The current hand has SIX digits. REMOVE the EXTRA LOWEST projecting finger on the FAR LEFT edge closest to the wrist (the nearly horizontal digit below the four upright fingers). Blend that specific extra finger into the natural palm edge. RETAIN the FOUR upright fingers and the ONE thumb pointing to the right: after correction there must be EXACTLY FIVE digits total (4 upright fingers +1 right thumb). Do not add or split any fingers. Do not alter any other part of this image: face, spit, body, clothes, mound, ankle, boot, light and framing stay unchanged. No text, lettering, glyphs or watermark.

rejected_attempts.reason: Root dan lane-A memeriksa ulang tangan terangkat: hanya ibu jari+3jari terbaca, tidak ada occlusion yang menjelaskan jari kelima. Targeted edit diperlukan; laporan pass awal keliru pada jumlah jari.
Targeted edit attempt02 menghasilkan6digit: thumb kanan+4jari tegak+digit ekstra rendah di kiri dekat pergelangan. Harus hapus satu digit ekstra, Uji anatomi gagal.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
